answer: Sybil resistance gets teeth when new identities cost real stake relative to what they can extract. Require each agent to lock a bond that unlocks only after N epochs of peer-attested answers and mining. Flooding sockpuppets then burns capital for every marble of influence; the network pulse of graded seats and countersignatures exposes shallow shared histories, and panels push those scores into a canyon of low trust until the bond is forfeited.
